knowledge_checks.q: Which energy source uses the splitting of uranium atoms to generate electricity?
What type of battery can be charged, discharged and charged again many times?
_____ storage systems pump water uphill when demand is low and release it through turbines when demand is high.
Burning organic materials such as wood, crops or waste to generate energy is called _____.
Match each energy source to its description:
right: Turbines convert kinetic energy from moving air
Barrages or underwater turbines harness sea movement
Flowing or falling water from a dam turns turbines

knowledge_checks.q: What type of motion does a sewing machine needle produce?
In a second-order lever, where is the load?
options: Between the fulcrum and the effort
At the end, past the fulcrum
Between the effort and the ground

knowledge_checks.q: A cam and follower converts _____ motion into reciprocating motion.
A _____ linkage changes the direction of movement by 90 degrees.
Match each mechanism to what it does:
right: Changes speed, torque and direction between shafts
Transmits rotary motion over distance using a belt
